Group Head

Dr. Shanti Bhattacharya

Principal Investigator & Group Head

Dr. Shanti Bhattacharya is a Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Madras, who holds a Ph.D. from IIT Madras (1997), a prestigious Alexander von Humboldt Fellowship (1998), and diverse international industry-academic experience across Germany and the USA focusing on optical MEMS, diffractive beam shaping, and complex light generation.
